Here's a relaxed 3-day Jaipur plan with early starts and long afternoon rests, which suits parents.

Day 1, arrive and ease in: Check in and rest. In the evening, see Hawa Mahal from outside and stroll Johari Bazaar, then have dinner at a good Rajasthani thali place.
Day 2, forts and palaces: Go to Amber Fort early, before the crowds and the heat. Take a jeep up if the climb is too much. After lunch and a rest, visit City Palace and Jantar Mantar, which are close together.
Day 3, lakes, shopping and home: Stop at Jal Mahal for photos, then visit Albert Hall Museum. Buy block-print fabrics and jewellery at Bapu Bazaar before you leave. Birla Mandir at sunset is a calm option if you have the time.

Late October to March is the best season, so you're in a good window. A hired cab for all three days saves a lot of walking, and most monuments have a ticket for Indian citizens at a low rate, with senior discounts at some.
